artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: The DB-i-19 live read cell. Imports run_real from the round-129 run script by path, the adapter InflectionSilverReader, and lib/trading_calendar. Reads the landed silver and the bronze envelopes through the GET-only reader; writes only the private directory and the record file. Holds no write, vendor, credential or s3 literal. Run once on dell2 in this session: status RAN, rc 0.

The run record: script hash, private extract hash, the run_real return value, the day-level agreement counts, the verdict MANIFEST_AGREES, the read counts and the basis words. Counts and verdict words only; no value, date, account or household id. Checked by p132_live.py DBI132-1-AC1 (PASS).
The session log of the steps, invocations and results, with the write counters (all zero).
Three rows appended as bytes, IRPT_DASHBD-D2-W319-S1 to S3, each OBSERVATION and INERT with grounding. The append-only prefix is unchanged. The commit carries the surprise-row gate's OK line.

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: `DBI132-1-AC1` -- the record is complete and carries no identifier or date; the script is a tracked file hashed as recorded with no write, vendor-call or credential token, built on `InflectionSilverReader`, taking trading days from `lib/trading_calendar.py`; the extract's hash equals the recorded one; the run status is `RAN`; the day count, the per-day agreement of the silver row count with the bronze manifest, the trading-day count from the calendar, accounts x trading days = rows_present + rows_absent and `trading_days_unaccounted` 0 all equal the checker's recompute from the extract; no write, no push, no deploy. Base: FAIL (no record).
acceptance.output_evidence: DBI132-1-AC1 PASS (rc 0; the same line and rc 0 on two runs). The checker's own recompute from the private extract: days_total 1, days_manifest_agree 1, days_manifest_disagree 0, trading_days_in_window 1, expected_rows 863 equal to rows_accounted 863 (rows_present 795 plus rows_absent 68), trading_days_unaccounted 0, verdict MANIFEST_AGREES.
acceptance.denominator: 1 of 1 criterion PASS (the checker's sub-clauses on the one landed day: record keys against the whitelist, script clean-scan, extract hash, run status RAN, 5 recounted fields, expected_rows, rows_accounted, trading_days_unaccounted, verdict; every clause reached PASS)

mutant.description: The checker's own self-test: a GOOD record built from the feed's own writer, then ten mutants (wrong verdict, wrong day count, rows not accounted, trading days unaccounted, run not RAN, s3 write read as zero, a date in the record, a manifest that disagrees in the extract, a put_object script, a script with its own weekday helper).
mutant.expected: GOOD PASS and each of the ten mutants FAIL
mutant.observed: python -I p132_live.py --selftest . printed GOOD PASS and ten FAIL lines, each naming its reason; selftest PASS rc 0

determinism.method: two same-input runs of the criterion, PASS lines compared
determinism.observed: DBI132-1-AC1 PASS and rc 0 on both runs
